job.title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
job.pay_full: $133,100 – $210,600 a year typical starting base salary ($159,900 – $252,900 in Seattle, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City metro area), plus eligibility for Elastic's stock program

details.about: Elastic makes the Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than half of the Fortune 500 for search, security and observability. This Senior Software Engineer joins the Elasticsearch Distributed Systems team, focused on how Elasticsearch delivers scale, performance and resilience, especially in its Serverless offering: how cluster nodes communicate, and how data is indexed, allocated and managed across nodes.
duties: Build and operate core pieces of the next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering
Improve the components behind concurrent, consistent indexing across many machines
Maintain the cluster coordination system so performance stays high as nodes come and go and data moves, while keeping the system safe and live
Push the limits on how many shards, nodes and petabytes Elasticsearch can handle
Investigate performance and concurrency issues and propose fixes, owning investigations end to end
Help support engineers with the hardest problems
needs: Deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms
Strong core Java skills, including the standard library's data structures and concurrency constructs and newer language features
Proven work on complex, highly distributed systems, beyond using off-the-shelf services
Ability to build and debug broad-impact features running on multiple machines, and own projects from design to delivery
A track record of using AI to speed up development, debug complex systems and optimize code, while owning the outcome
Ability to collaborate across teams and work autonomously in a distributed team with asynchronous, direct communication
nice: Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty
details.benefits: Typical starting base salary $133,100 – $210,600 a year; in select locations (Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA and the New York City metro area) the range is $159,900 – $252,900. Pay is base salary only, with no variable component. The role is eligible for Elastic's stock program, and benefits include a company-matched 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings.
notes: Elastic describes itself as a distributed company

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll build core pieces of serverless Elasticsearch, improve indexing and cluster coordination, and push how many nodes and petabytes it can handle.

Experience with Lucene, Netty, or data stores is a bonus.
